properties.finite_contract: Exact finite parse outcome, nilness, source-defined error identity/NumError shape, and successful field preservation. Normative validity is separate from library representation support.
For these finite successfully parsed pairs, metadata is preserved in fields/string but does not determine comparison precedence.
Finite normal prerelease ordering plus explicit both-uint64-overflow discrepancy pairs. Numeric expectation uses SemVer decimal magnitude, not the candidate comparator.
Finite anchored slash-based matching with single-star and component globstar boundaries. No filesystem, PathMatch or OS-dependent behavior.
Finite escaped-metacharacter and question-mark behavior. ASCII core and three valid-UTF8 Unicode boundary vectors are explicitly separate.

Finite syntax failure and exact own ErrBadPattern, with separate whole-pattern validation and first-success matching observables. Stronger strict validation policy is not called an upstream guarantee.
